description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  

 You'll help federal, state and local government agencies implement agile solution and turn insights into action to improve their efficiency and to help them better serve their constituencies.  

 Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. 
 
 
Job Description Summary
Huron is seeking a skilled and motivated Salesforce Developer / OmniStudio to join our fast growing Public Sector team. This role will support a federal civilian space sector client in a complex, mission driven environment focused on application modernization, platform enhancement, secure service delivery, and long term operational excellence.
This individual will work through Huron in a multi partner delivery environment, collaborating closely with client stakeholders, partner teams, and cross functional technical resources to design, build, enhance, and sustain Salesforce based solutions. This is an opportunity to join a growing team that is building a strong long term pool of consultants to support both this engagement and future public sector clients as they pursue modernization and transformation goals. 

The ideal candidate brings strong Salesforce development experience, deep OmniStudio expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly regulated, security conscious environment. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications using both declarative and programmatic capabilities

 Build and support OmniStudio solutions, including Integration Procedures, DataRaptors, OmniScripts, and FlexCards 

 Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and partner teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions

 Support enterprise platform transformation, enhancement, and sustainment efforts across a distributed and highly collaborative delivery environment

 Develop solutions that align with security, compliance, privacy, and operational requirements common to federal clients

 Participate in Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand ups, demos, and retrospectives

 Contribute to secure software delivery practices across the full system development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support

 Support integration efforts across enterprise platforms and external systems using APIs and middleware technologies

 Produce and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, configuration documentation, support materials, and user guidance

 Assist with troubleshooting, defect resolution, performance tuning, and ongoing platform support

 Support audit readiness, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and continuous improvement activities as required in government aligned environments

 Required Qualifications 
 Proven experience as a Salesforce Developer or Salesforce Administrator in enterprise environments

 Hands on experience delivering solutions with Salesforce OmniStudio 

 Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, including:
 Apex 

 Visualforce 

 Lightning Components 

 Lightning Web Components 

 Flow 

 Salesforce APIs 

 
 Experience with REST, SOAP, and Bulk API integrations

 Experience with SOQL , Salesforce data modeling, and relational databases

 Experience with modern development tools such as Visual Studio Code and Git 

 Strong understanding of Apex bulkification, governor limits, and performance best practices

 Experience working in Agile delivery environments

 Strong problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills

 Ability to work effectively across Huron, partner teams, and client stakeholders in a multi team environment

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting federal civilian agencies or similarly regulated environments

 Experience with MuleSoft or similar middleware and integration platforms

 Familiarity with Public Sector Solutions, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud 

 Experience supporting environments with strong requirements for cybersecurity, privacy, access control, auditability, and compliance 

 Familiarity with zero trust principles , secure development practices, and operational controls in government settings

 Experience in Scaled Agile and/or ITIL aligned delivery organizations

 Experience contributing to application modernization and long term sustainment programs in large, distributed environments

 Education and Certifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

 One or more of the following certifications required:
 Salesforce Platform Developer I 

 Salesforce Platform App Builder 

 Salesforce Advanced Administrator 

 
 Additional Salesforce, integration, or public sector relevant certifications are a plus

 Eligibility and Security Requirements 
 Must be US based and a US Citizen 
 Please inform us of any Dual citizenship when applying since it may require client pre-approval.

 
 Some projects and positions may require security clearances or background checks such as
 DD2875, Favorable T3/ANACI/NACLC* or higher (BI)

 
 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain required background investigation and access credentials for a federal client environment

 Must be able to meet identity, credentialing, and access requirements, including badging and secure system access

 Certain responsibilities may require the ability to satisfy elevated investigation, privileged access, or security related requirements depending on role assignment

 Why Join Huron 
 Be part of Huron’s fast growing Public Sector team 

 Contribute to meaningful, mission focused work that supports critical public sector operations

 Work in a collaborative multi partner environment alongside experienced consultants, technologists, and client stakeholders

 Join a team that is building a long term team of high impact consultants to support this client and future public sector engagements

 Help public sector organizations modernize platforms, strengthen operations, and achieve long term transformation goals

 Working Environment 
 This role is expected to support a primarily remote delivery model, with occasional travel as required by client or program needs. Team members should be comfortable working across distributed teams and coordinating within structured delivery, governance, and reporting processes.
 The estimated base salary for this job is $105,000 - $130,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $120,750 - $149,500. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.
 
 
 Position Level 
Associate 
 
 Country 
United States of America
